text: APPROVE: `GatherLcov` is reduced to a foreach plus two calls, and the new helpers score roughly 3 and 7, all under 15. Behaviour is unchanged, including partial `found`/`hit` accumulation before an `IOException` (preserved through `ref`) and the swallowed catch, and the `CHA0004` pragma still covers the catch. I only had the diff, so I could not confirm that no existing method already uses the names `MergeReportRows` or `AddBranchTotals`, and I did not run a build.
